gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ by a locally trained architect.
gaps.explanation: 'Was designed by' — passive with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: The results ___ (publish) on the university website next Friday.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'Next Friday' fixes the future reference.

gaps.sentence: Your name ___ (find) anywhere on the guest list, I'm afraid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of ability/possibility: cannot be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The passengers ___ to fasten their seatbelts as the plane entered the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'The passengers were told to …' — passive of 'tell somebody to do'.

gaps.sentence: English ___ (speak) as a first language in more than fifty countries.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: is + spoken. Facts about the language, not about a speaker.

gaps.sentence: A cheaper version of the vaccine ___ right now.
gaps.explanation: 'Right now' requires present continuous passive: is being + developed.

gaps.sentence: Your booking ___ (confirm) by email — check your spam folder.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + confirmed; the confirmation exists now.

gaps.sentence: We had the whole house ___ (repaint) before the wedding.
gaps.explanation: 'Had the house repainted' — painters did it at our request. Object + past participle.
